spec: METHODOLOGY.md M4 / §6 (paper revision plan): (a) bug-id scrub, (b) distinctive-term rename, (c) failure-path FILE/TYPE rename, (d) failure-path LOG-STATEMENT rewrite. Both logs are then regenerated from the anonymized build so their literals and stack frames match source/. Generic system identifiers in code bodies (znode, session, zxid, quorum, leader/follower/observer roles, snapshot/txnlog vocabulary, package paths) are KEPT — the LLM may know it is ZooKeeper.
regeneration: private/anonymize.sh (deterministic: clone at pre_fix_commit -> deps-fix.patch -> one single-pass substitution of (b)+(c)+(d) over src/java + src/zookeeper.jute -> file renames -> ant jar -> source/ -> reproduce.sh => logs/repro.log -> private/merge_logs.py => logs/symptom.log). All substitutions come from ONE map applied in a SINGLE pass, longest key first, so a replacement is never re-replaced and every key matches the pristine upstream spelling.

a_bug_id_scrub.note: Zero hits across source/, logs/repro.log and the 1.6 GB logs/symptom.log. The build tree is checked out at the neutral path repos/zookeeper-ensemble-src (the JVM prints user.dir + the classpath into every log line block), reproduction ports are 2461x/2462x/2463x, and each reproduction client stays under ~1500 requests so no client's request xid reaches 1900. The shared production log contains no bare 1900 either (checked whole).

b_distinctive_term_renames.original: truncate / truncateLog / truncated / truncating / truncation / TRUNC / Truncate*
b_distinctive_term_renames.anonymized: rollBack / rollBackLog / rolledBack / rewinding / rewind / ROLLBACK / RollBack*
b_distinctive_term_renames.why: The JIRA title is 'NullPointerException in truncate' and the report quotes the frame 'FileTxnLog.truncate(FileTxnLog.java:352)'. The word 'truncate' next to the transaction-log class is the token a reader would grep to recall the ticket.
b_distinctive_term_renames.sites: TxnLog.truncate (interface), FileTxnLog.truncate (the root-cause method), FileTxnSnapLog.truncateLog, ZKDatabase.truncateLog, ZooKeeperServer.truncateLog, the Leader.TRUNC constant (int 14) and its "TRUNC" packet-name literal, local variables truncated/truncLog, every doc comment, and the test class TruncateTest -> RollBackTest.

c_failure_path_type_renames.why: Blocks 'I recognize FileTxnLog.truncate / Observer.observeLeader -> this is ZOOKEEPER-1900' mapping from parametric memory. The set is exactly the fix-diff files plus every file named in the symptom-log stack trace. File name and public type are renamed together; every reference (imports, calls, log tags, stack frames, the Jute record) follows. The grader translates the LLM's anonymized answer back through this table (§8).

renames.role: root-cause site 1 (fix diff) + top stack frame

stack frame (syncWithLeader); carries the whole Learner* family (LearnerType, LearnerInfo, LearnerZooKeeperServer, LearnerSessionTracker, LearnerSyncRequest, LearnerCnxAcceptor, LearnerSnapshotThrottler, SyncedLearnerTracker)
leader-side counterpart that selects the roll-back branch; named explicitly so it does not become PeerSynchronizerHandler

c_failure_path_type_renames.note: src/zookeeper.jute is substituted too: the Jute compiler generates LearnerInfo from it at build time, so without that the generated class keeps the original name and the tree does not compile. Renaming QuorumPeerMain moves the entry point, so reproduce.sh takes MAIN_CLASS from the environment (org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.EnsembleMemberMain for the anonymized tree).

d_failure_path_log_statement_rewrites.why: So the symptom-log strings cannot be string-matched to the JIRA report or recognized from parametric memory. Wording changes; the kind of information (level, subsystem tag, the zxid/sid fields) is preserved, so the log still reads like real system output.

production_log_handling.shared_log: production-logs/Zookeeper/production.log (1.5 GB, 8 052 741 records, 7-node ensemble under YCSB + chaos monkey) — READ-ONLY, never modified.
production_log_handling.problem: It is real ZooKeeper output, so it contains the very names (c) renames and the (d) wording: 2 193 202 lines mention LearnerHandler, 1 902 726 carry the 'QuorumPeer[myid=' thread tag, plus FileTxnLog (47), FileTxnSnapLog (60), QuorumPeerConfig (28), QuorumPeerMain (21), 'Synchronizing with Follower sid' (6), 'Snapshotting:' (32), 'Creating new log file' (33), 'Getting a diff from the leader' (6), 'Received NEWLEADER-ACK' (6).
production_log_handling.resolution: The same map is applied to the production stream while building THIS bug's merged logs/symptom.log (merge_logs.py --rename). Without it the merged log would contradict source/, re-expose every original name in the noise, and make the reproduction lines stand out as the only differently-worded ones. METHODOLOGY M4 step 1 sanctions rewriting such occurrences in the production noise. The shared file itself is untouched.

kept_unchanged: every class not on the failure path (ZooKeeperServer, Follower, Leader, PrepRequestProcessor, CommitProcessor, FinalRequestProcessor, NIOServerCnxn, ClientCnxn, Request, DataTree, FileSnap, Util, ...)

the lower-case role words leader / follower / observer / learner (they appear in zoo.cfg as peerType=observer and server.N=...:observer, so renaming them would break the configuration), and LearnerType.OBSERVER
znode / session / zxid / epoch / quorum / snapshot / txnlog vocabulary in code bodies
the log format, levels and thread-tag structure
the java.lang.NullPointerException type and the full stack shape
verification: private/anonymize.sh step 7, over source/ + logs/repro.log + the whole 1.6 GB logs/symptom.log: the bug id, bare 1900, [Tt]runcat, TRUNC, and every original failure-path type name (FileTxnLog, FileTxnSnapLog, FileTxnIterator, ZKDatabase, Learner, LearnerHandler, QuorumPeer, Observer) → all zero hits. symptom.md is verified by M5's own gate.
